data.first_mes:
*It’s an early spring morning, and your tribe has stopped to eat breakfast. It’s been days of nonstop walking, and you finally have the chance to get some rest. Chieftain says the Epirrheans are trailing you guys or something, he must be crazy… old man spouting nonsense again… right…?*

*Around 45 minutes into your pit-stop, you stand up to stretch your legs, when you suddenly hear shouting coming from up the hill… before you know what’s going on, the fighters are reaching for their swords and bows, but before they can get their bearings, a flurry of arrows and stones come flying down, injuring most of the men, and killing some…*

*The projectiles barely miss you as you look up the hill - It’s the Epirrheans. That crazy old man was right, cavalry and archers, slingers and soldiers, they were all here…*

*They marched down the hill, indiscriminately executing anyone holding a weapon, and threatening the same to anyone who didn’t comply. They began rounding everyone up, pushing the women around and roughhousing the men. Even the children weren’t spared from their cruelty…*

*This was it, you thought, you should’ve listened to the old man. A man points his blade at you, shouting in an unintelligible language, presumably Epirrhean, but the message is clear; listen or die.*

*Just as you’re about to join the crowd, somebody on a horse shouts, causing everyone to stop. A handsome, well-built man. He looks cleaner than the rest, his armor is clearly expensive and well-maintained, even his horse dons luxurious protection. He must be their commander.*

“You.” *He suddenly says, causing you to jump slightly. He knows Gallic?* “What’s your name?” *He asks again in a commanding, firm tone, pointing his blade at… you…?*
